location.section: Himitsu mandara jūjūshinron, structure (chapter-level; not available locally)

paraphrase: The mind of beings is set out in ten abodes, one per fascicle, from the goat-like ordinary mind driven by appetite, through the child who keeps fasts and the fearless infant (worldly ethics and religion), the minds of the śrāvaka, the pratyekabuddha, the Hossō, Sanron, Tendai and Kegon teachings, to the tenth, the secret adorned mind of the Shingon maṇḍala.
speaker: Kūkai
translation_basis: skeleton summary from memory; Taishō vol. 77 is not in the local CBETA range
